note: Nothing here is verified. Every item awaits a domain expert.

entries.current_rule: Refer to physician/haematologist when absolute neutrophils < 0.5 x10^9/L (diffSevereNeutropenia) or eosinophils > 1.5 x10^9/L (diffMarkedEosinophilia), evaluated on the unrounded value; reference flags use the 2-decimal displayed value.
Eosinophilia refer threshold > 1.5 x10^9/L; strict vs inclusive boundary and unrounded-vs-displayed policy not expert-confirmed.
Adult-only absolute reference limits (neutrophils 1.83-7.25, lymphocytes 1.5-4.0, monocytes 0.2-0.95, eosinophils <=0.7, basophils <=0.15 x10^9/L; bands <=6 %); paediatric limits absent.
entries.source_reference: Harrison Manual 20e table 64-1 (as cited in repo), Lyubina 1984; P0-1c

entries.current_rule: Refer wording (uz/ru/en): do not interpret blast/unidentified cell yourself; haematologist or physician reviews per lab procedure.

entries.symbol: G1 and G2 do not meet the criteria
entries.current_rule: Calculator shows KDIGO G category and a note that G1/G2 without kidney damage are not CKD, but no chronicity (>3 months) sentence; a single eGFR is not a CKD diagnosis.
KDIGO G category computed from the integer-rounded eGFR (59.89 -> 60 -> G2); policy differs from the ANC unrounded policy.
Analyte card states kidney failure as "15 or less" while the calculator uses <15 for G5.
Corrected Ca = Ca(mg/dL) - albumin(g/dL) + 4.0 (Payne 1973); alternative 0.8/0.02 variants not adopted.
entries.source_reference: Payne RB et al. BMJ 1973;4:643-6 (cited in code comment); C02

entries.current_rule: Platelet decision limits: <150k low, mild 100-150k, moderate 50-100k, serious <50k, severe <20k; band edges overlap at 100k/50k/20k (one bound must be exclusive).
entries.source_reference: NHLBI platelet classification (card population text); C14

entries.current_rule: Ferritin <30 ug/L suggests iron deficiency; inflammation raises ferritin; ODS page to be re-opened.
LDL goals (ATP III 2001 <100 mg/dL for CHD/equivalents); ESC 2025 comparison open (EXPERT_QUESTIONS #8).
Smear within 3 h; do not refrigerate EDTA blood.
Specific gravity >1.020 dehydration/glycosuria; <1.003 marked dilution; glucosuria threshold 180-200 mg/dL; nitrite false positives.
Pre-transfusion sample retained at least 3 days after transfusion.
Calibration outcome default is pending; accepted requires approver and QC form rules (calibration safety); acceptance criteria are app rules, not manufacturer limits.
Record fields: approver, QC-after-calibration, SOP reference, training-vs-real marking; whether the log is a training journal or a lab record.
Records can be deleted with no history (local, on device).
Exact match on maker + model + reagent REF + IFU revision (+ calibrator lot if bound); analyteId and reagent maker not compared; no fuzzy match; pack ifu_records empty.
entries.required_reviewer_role: Laboratory quality manager / IFU document owner
